description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter.

next.name: analyze
tip: Run analysis over Python source code.

next.name: graph
tip: Generate a map of Python file dependencies or dependents.

next.name: help
tip: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s).

next.name: check
tip: Run Ruff on the given files or directories.

option.name: --add-ignore
tip: Enable automatic additions of ruff:ignore comments to failing lines.

option.name: --add-noqa
tip: Enable automatic additions of noqa directives to failing lines.

option.name: --diff
tip: Output a diff for each changed file to stdout.

option.name: --exclude
tip: List of paths to omit from analysis.

option.name: --exit-non-zero-on-fix
tip: Exit with a non-zero status code if any files were modified via fix.

option.name: --exit-zero
tip: Exit with status code 0, even upon detecting lint violations.

option.name: --extend-exclude
tip: Like --exclude, but adds additional files and directories.

option.name: --extend-select
tip: Like --select, but adds additional rule codes on top of those already specified.

option.name: --extension
tip: List of mappings from file extension to language.

option.name: --fix
tip: Apply fixes to resolve lint violations.
Use --no-fix to disable or --unsafe-fixes to include unsafe fixes.

option.name: --fix-only
tip: Apply fixes but don't report leftover violations.

option.name: --fixable
tip: List of rule codes to treat as eligible for fix.

option.name: --force-exclude
tip: Enforce exclusions, even for paths passed directly on the command-line.

option.name: --ignore
tip: Comma-separated list of rule codes to disable.

option.name: --output-file
tip: Specify file to write the linter output to.

option.name: --output-format
tip: Possible values: concise, full, json, json-lines, junit, grouped, github, gitlab, pylint, rdjson, azure, sarif

option.name: --per-file-ignores
tip: List of mappings from file pattern to code to exclude.

option.name: --preview
tip: Enable preview mode; checks will include unstable rules and fixes.

option.name: --select
tip: Comma-separated list of rule codes to enable (or ALL).

option.name: --show-files
tip: See the files Ruff will be run against with the current settings.

option.name: --show-fixes
tip: Show an enumeration of all fixed lint violations.

option.name: --show-settings
tip: See the settings Ruff will use to lint a given Python file.

option.name: --statistics
tip: Show counts for every rule with at least one violation.

option.name: --stdin-filename
tip: The name of the file when passing it through stdin.

option.name: --target-version
tip: The minimum Python version that should be supported.
Possible values: py37, py38, py39, py310, py311, py312, py313, py314, py315

option.name: --unfixable
tip: List of rule codes to treat as ineligible for fix.

option.name: --unsafe-fixes
tip: Include fixes that may not retain the original intent of the code.

option.name: --watch
tip: Run in watch mode by re-running whenever files change.

next.name: clean
tip: Clear any caches in the current directory and any subdirectories.

next.name: config
tip: List or describe the available configuration options.

next.name: format
tip: Run the Ruff formatter on the given files or directories.

option.name: --check
tip: Avoid writing any formatted files back.
Exit with non-zero status code if any files would have been modified.

option.name: --diff
tip: Output the difference between current and formatted file.

option.name: --exclude
tip: List of paths to omit from analysis.

option.name: --exit-non-zero-on-format
tip: Exit with a non-zero status code if any files were modified via format.

option.name: --extend-exclude
tip: Like --exclude, but adds additional files and directories.

option.name: --extension
tip: List of mappings from file extension to language.

option.name: --force-exclude
tip: Enforce exclusions, even for paths passed directly on the command-line.

option.name: --output-format
tip: Output serialization format for violations, when used with --check.

option.name: --preview
tip: Enable preview mode; enables unstable formatting.

option.name: --range
tip: Only format the code in the given range.

option.name: --stdin-filename
tip: The name of the file when passing it through stdin.

option.name: --target-version
tip: The minimum Python version that should be supported.

option.name: --color
tip: Control when colored output is used.

next.name: auto
tip: Display colors if the output goes to an interactive terminal.

option.name: --config
tip: Either a path to a TOML configuration file, or a TOML key-value pair.

global_option.name: --config
tip: Path to a TOML configuration file or a key-value pair.
